title: Page 10
slug: 仇人逼我嫁-芳妮-孟佳梨没想到当年老被她保护的小胖子竟变成眼前的帅哥总裁-他曾发誓以后换他保护她可现在欺负她最狠的就是他
content_zh:
难怪人家都说女儿是父亲前世的情人，这句话可是一点都不假。

“天地可表，日月可鉴，我耿柏恩最爱的是我的亲亲妻子孟佳梨，不管什么儿子啦女儿啦、阿猫阿狗啦，全都远远及不上我老婆在我心目中的地位。”耿柏恩神色一肃，举起手来郑重宣示。

“还阿猫阿狗呢，我生得出来吗我？”孟佳梨被逗得轻笑出声，伸出手轻轻拍了耿柏恩一下。

他在半空中握住了她的手，黝黑的俊眸溢满了浓浓的爱意，深深瞅着她道：“我要你一辈子都这样开心的笑。”他绝对不让她再流一滴泪。

孟佳梨感动的点点头，反手与他十指紧扣，正要响应这份感动时，眉头却突然盐了紧，忍不住又“啊”了声。

“女儿又踢你了？”耿柏恩看着她的肚子，故作威吓的道：“乖女儿，别乱踢我老婆，否则把拔真的会打你屁屁喔。”

“柏恩……”

“放心，我不会舍不得的。”耿柏恩含笑扬睫，却望进一双饱含痛楚的水眸，下一刻，那双眸子忽地翻白，整个人瘫软的倒入他怀中。

“佳梨？老婆？醒醒！”耿柏恩的心脏彷佛随着她的昏厥而停止了跳动，飞快的抱起她往车库跑。

在屋内的耿安茜及佣人听到了外面的动静，纷纷奔出屋外探看，却只见耿柏恩已经抱着孟佳梨上车，旋即大踩油门，疾速驶离了家门。

耿柏恩完全不知道自己是怎么将车开到医院的，直到医护人员将孟佳梨接过去，他还恍如梦中，耳边依稀还听得到孟佳梨的柔声细语与轻笑声。

“柏恩，现在状况如何？”杨子谦闻讯赶来，在急诊室找到了面如死灰的耿柏恩，急切的询问。

耿柏恩摇摇头，一向犀利的黑眸此刻却呆滞无神，彷佛整个人都失了魂。

杨子谦皱皱眉，摇摇他的肩膀道：“振作点，她们现在需要你。”

耿柏恩看向他，双眸微微泛红，沙哑着声音道：“我也在等医生说明。”

杨子谦被耿柏恩的神色给吓到了，前几次他也没有这么失态，连一向镇定冷净的商场强人都如此六神无主，难道这次……杨子谦实在不敢再想下去。

就在一片寂静与绝望笼罩在两人身上时，就见一群护理人员匆匆将孟佳梨推进手术室，并有医生和护理人员朝他们迅速走来。

“医生，我太太现在怎样？”耿柏恩瞬间回神，马上冲到医生面前询问。

“耿先生，您太太的状况危急，我们现在必须要马上替她剖腹生产，否则母女均危，若只能保住一个的话……”

“保大人，拜托你，一定要救救我老婆，求求你。”耿柏恩突然握住医生的手，朝他跪了下来，让医生跟杨子谦同时错愕的怔住了。

“耿先生您请起，我们一定会尽全力的。”医生试图扶起他，却徒劳无功，耿柏恩依然紧握着他的手，动也不动的跪着。

“柏恩，你别这样，快让医生去手术室去救佳梨跟孩子！”杨子谦赶紧上前帮忙扶起他。

耿柏恩这才如梦初醒，松开了手道：“麻烦你了，请你一定要救我妻子。”

医生随即快步冲去做术前准备，护理人员则向耿柏恩说明状况，并让他签署手术同意书。

待签署完厚厚的文件，耿柏恩全身的力气彷佛又被抽离了似的，靠着墙壁滑坐在地板上，一双发红的眼睛始终没有离开过手术室门口，嘴巴不住的重复低喃，“老婆，你会没事的，别怕，我爱你。”

看着耿柏恩失魂落魄的模样，杨子谦的心狠狠的揪了起来，谁会料到在爱情面前，一向冷酷强势的男人也会变得这么脆弱不堪？

他现在才知道，在耿柏恩对孟佳梨的爱面前，自己那份情意有多渺小了。

佳梨，你一定要没事，否则耿柏恩肯定也撑不下去啊……

杨子谦将视线自耿柏恩身上移往手术室的门口，暗暗的祈祷着。

孟佳梨好像作了很漫长的梦，一场怎么都醒不过来的恶梦。

梦中她似乎听到了耿柏恩的低泣，以及亲朋好友的缅怀想念，还有狗儿的长啸哀鸣。

她在梦中被团团白雾所困，即便她试图想要挥开迷雾，努力朝着那些声音的方向走去，那团扰人的雾气却始终层层包围着她、阻碍着她，让她无法辨识前方的路。

她走得好累好累，她想要回家，想回到那个有耿柏恩的家，可是她好累好累，脚步彷佛灌了铅般沉重。

她走不动了，她好困好困，一步都走不动了。

“哇——哇——”

忽地，一阵阵婴儿的哭泣声穿过了白雾，传入她疲惫的脑海，宛如打了一剂强心针，让她整个人猛的清醒——

孩子……她的孩子？是她跟耿柏恩的女儿？！

“哇哇哇——哇哇——”

她在哭？别哭孩子，妈咪马上去找你！

不知哪里来的力气，孟佳梨又迈开了步伐，一步步往前方走去。

滚开，别阻挡我！我要回家！

她奋力伸出手拨开弥漫在四周的白雾，大声的嘶吼着，直到那挥舞的手被一双温暖的大掌紧紧握住，白雾瞬间消散无踪，她骤地睁开双眼，望进了一双布满血丝的含泪俊眸，飘浮的心彷佛同时踏实的落在地上，在耿柏恩激动的呼唤声及女儿响亮的哭声中，虚弱的扯开了唇，“我回来了。”

回到他跟女儿的身边，回到她的家，回到所有的爱中，再也不分开。

——全书完

霸凌　芳妮

最近新闻上闹得沸沸扬扬的，除了缺水跟毒茶叶之外，应该就是“霸凌”了，以往的霸凌，是现实生活中，面对面的欺负与排挤，可随着时代的进步，霸凌也跟着进步了，不管认识不认识的人，透过网络，随时可以对某人某事发表意见，甚至不分青红皂白的辱骂，只因为自己不爽，丝毫不顾及对方的情绪与反应，只想发泄自己的不满。

这真是个很糟糕的时代与行为。

网络带给大家便利，却也引出隐藏在某些人内心最深层的丑陋，反正不用面对面，只需要在键盘上打几个字，随便评论别人，毁谤辱骂，简直比吃饭还要简单，而且似乎还可以不用负责任，让越来越多人乐此不疲的利用网络去霸凌别人。

其实这些在网络上言词锐利，毫不留情批判别人的匿名者，在现实中，或许是个温和亲切好相处的人，可一遇到网络，就好像疯了，狂了，变身成一个连他自己都不认识的言语暴力者，只因为可以藏匿在网络之后，不管怎么违反道德正义，跨过危险的那条线，关机之后，这些似乎都可以抛在脑后，继续维持在现实生活中的形象。

但这些网络霸凌者却没想到，或许自己只是一时冲动的宣泄，却可能逼死一个与自己素昧平生、完全没交集的陌生人，只因为自己的道听涂说，以讹传讹，又或者因为自己崇拜的偶像分享转发的文章，就不顾真假，不去查证，一味附和，非把那陌生人往死里讲才甘愿罢休。

这是多病态的行为啊。

霸凌本就是件残害生命的行为，而网络霸凌更加速生命的凋零，因为网络的力量不再局限于三、五人，而是数百数千，甚至上万人的言语暴力，让受害者连反击都不知该如何反击。

虽然有人会说，因此就自杀的人，抗压性也未免太低，但为何不想想，如果没有这些莫名其妙的网络霸凌的“因”，又怎么会有今天这个自杀的“果”？
content_en:
No wonder people say that the daughter was her father's lover in his previous life. This statement is not false at all.

"The heaven and the earth can be represented, and the sun and the moon can be learned. What I, Geng Bo'en, love most is my biological wife Meng Jiali. No matter what my son, daughter, cat or dog, they are all far inferior to the status of my wife in my heart." Geng Bo'en looked solemn and raised his hand to declare solemnly.

"Where are the cats and dogs? Can I give birth to me?" Meng Jiali was so amused that she chuckled and stretched out her hand to pat Geng Bo'en gently.

He held her hand in mid-air, his dark handsome eyes filled with deep love, looked at her deeply and said, "I want you to smile happily like this all your life." He would never let her shed another tear.

Meng Jiali nodded excitedly, and clasped her fingers with his backhand. Just when she was about to respond to this move, her brows suddenly tightened, and she couldn't help but say "Ah" again.

"Did your daughter kick you again?" Geng Bo'en looked at her belly and pretended to be threatening: "Good daughter, don't kick my wife, otherwise I will really spank you."

"Born..."

"Don't worry, I won't be reluctant to let you go." Geng Bo'en smiled and raised his eyelashes, but looked into a pair of watery eyes full of pain. The next moment, those eyes suddenly turned white, and the whole person fell limply into his arms.

"Jia Li? Wife? Wake up!" Geng Boen's heart seemed to have stopped beating as she fainted, and he quickly picked her up and ran to the garage.

Geng Anqian and the servants who were in the house heard the noise outside, and rushed out to check, only to see that Geng Bo'en had already carried Meng Jiali into the car, and then stepped on the accelerator and drove away from the house at high speed.

Geng Bo'en had no idea how he drove the car to the hospital. Until the medical staff took Meng Jiali over, he was still in a dream, and he could still vaguely hear Meng Jiali's soft whispers and chuckles in his ears.

"Born, how are you doing now?" Yang Ziqian rushed over after hearing the news, found the ashen-faced Geng Bowen in the emergency room, and asked eagerly.

Geng Bo'en shook his head. His usually sharp black eyes were dull at the moment, as if he had lost his soul.

Yang Ziqian frowned, shook his shoulders and said, "Cheer up, they need you now."

Geng Bo'en looked at him, his eyes were slightly red, and he said in a hoarse voice: "I'm also waiting for the doctor's explanation."

Yang Ziqian was frightened by Geng Boen's expression. He had not lost his composure like this a few times before. Even the always calm and cool shopping mall strongman was so confused. Could it be that this time... Yang Ziqian really didn't dare to think about it anymore.

Just when silence and despair enveloped the two of them, they saw a group of nursing staff hurriedly pushing Meng Jiali into the operating room, and doctors and nursing staff walked quickly towards them.

"Doctor, how is my wife now?" Geng Bo'en came to his senses instantly and rushed to the doctor to ask.

"Mr. Geng, your wife's condition is critical. We must give her a caesarean section immediately. Otherwise, both mother and daughter will be in danger. If only one can be saved..."

"Master Bao, please, please save my wife, please." Geng Bo'en suddenly held the doctor's hand and knelt down towards him, making the doctor and Yang Ziqian stunned at the same time.

"Mr. Geng, please get up. We will do our best." The doctor tried to help him up, but in vain. Geng Bo'en still held his hand tightly and knelt motionless.

"Bo En, don't be like this. Let the doctor go to the operating room to save Jia Li and the child!" Yang Ziqian quickly stepped forward to help him up.

Geng Bo'en just woke up from a dream, let go of his hand and said: "Sorry to trouble you, please save my wife."

The doctor immediately rushed to make preoperative preparations, while the nursing staff explained the situation to Gunn and asked him to sign a consent form for the operation.

After signing the thick document, Geng Bo'en seemed to have been drained of all his strength. He slid against the wall and sat on the floor. His red eyes never left the door of the operating room. He kept mumbling repeatedly, "Honey, you will be fine. Don't be afraid, I love you."

Seeing Geng Boen's devastated look, Yang Ziqian's heart tugged hard. Who would have thought that a man who had always been cold and strong would become so fragile in the face of love?

Only now did he realize how insignificant his affection was in front of Geng Boen's love for Meng Jiali.

Jia Li, you must be fine, otherwise Geng Boen will definitely not be able to survive...

Yang Ziqian moved his gaze from Geng Boen to the door of the operating room, praying secretly.

Meng Jiali seemed to have had a very long dream, a nightmare from which she could not wake up.

In the dream, she seemed to hear Gunn's low cries, the remembrances of relatives and friends, and the long whining of dogs.

In her dream, she was trapped by a cloud of white fog. Even if she tried to wave away the fog and walk in the direction of those voices, the disturbing fog always surrounded her and hindered her, making it impossible for her to discern the road ahead.

She was so tired from walking, she wanted to go home, to the home where Bowen was, but she was so tired, her steps seemed as heavy as lead.

She couldn't walk anymore. She was so sleepy that she couldn't even take a step.

"Wow - wow -"

Suddenly, bursts of babies' cries passed through the white mist and entered her tired mind. It was like a shot in the arm, making her wake up suddenly——

The child...her child?Is she and Geng Boen's daughter?!

"Wow wow wow - wow wow -"

Is she crying?Don't cry, kid, Mommy will come find you right away!

Not knowing where she got the strength, Meng Jiali took another step and walked forward step by step.

Get out of here, don't stop me!I want to go home!

She stretched out her hand to push away the white mist that filled the surroundings, and roared loudly until her waving hand was tightly held by a pair of warm palms. The white mist instantly dissipated without a trace. She suddenly opened her eyes and looked into a pair of bloodshot and tearful eyes. Her floating heart seemed to fall to the ground at the same time. Amidst the excited call of Geng Boen and the loud cry of her daughter, she weakly opened her lips and said, "I'm back."

Return to him and his daughter, return to her home, return to all the love, and never separate again.

——Complete book

Bullying Fanny

What has been making a lot of noise in the news recently, apart from water shortages and poisonous tea leaves, should be "bullying". In the past, bullying was face-to-face bullying and exclusion in real life. But with the progress of the times, bullying has also improved. Regardless of whether you know people you know or not, through the Internet, you can express your opinions on someone or something at any time, and even abuse them indiscriminately, just because you are unhappy, without caring about the other person's emotions and reactions, and just want to vent your dissatisfaction.

This is a really bad time and behavior.

The Internet has brought convenience to everyone, but it has also brought out the deepest ugliness hidden in some people's hearts. Anyway, you don't have to face each other face to face. You only need to type a few words on the keyboard to comment on others, slander and insult. It is easier than eating. It seems that you can not be responsible, so more and more people are happy to use the Internet to bully others.

In fact, these anonymous people who speak sharply on the Internet and criticize others mercilessly may be gentle, kind and easy-to-get-together people in reality, but when they meet the Internet, they seem to go crazy and turn into verbal abusers that they do not even recognize. Just because they can hide behind the Internet, no matter how they violate moral justice or cross dangerous lines, after shutting down, it seems that these can be left behind and continue to maintain the image in real life.

But these online bullies never thought that maybe they were just venting impulsively, but they might drive a stranger to death with whom they had no connection. Just because they heard nonsense and spread rumors, or because their idols shared and reposted articles, they ignored the truth and did not verify, and just agreed, and they would not give up until the stranger was told to death.

What a sick behavior.

Bullying is an act that destroys lives, and cyberbullying accelerates the withering of lives, because the power of the Internet is no longer limited to three or five people, but verbal violence from hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of people, leaving victims without even knowing how to fight back.

Although some people may say that people who commit suicide because of this have low stress resistance, but why not think about it, if there were no "causes" of these inexplicable cyber bullying, how could there be the "effect" of committing suicide today?
